fusions.name: Rivet Popper
fusions.desc: Punches a fastening out of the target's guard, which deals 4 damage and leaves it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bulwark Ram
fusions.desc: Rams a plate forward on its pistons across a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 12 damage to everything in it and knocks each enemy back 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave it [Damped] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Ablative Layers
fusions.desc: Bolts on a stack of sacrificial plates that absorbs the next 26 damage, up to 5 blows, for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 6% while it holds.

fusions.name: Powered Cuirass
fusions.desc: Conjures a powered harness: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, your maximum health rises by 10, and 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
